task_title: Document the live MCP tool surface and transport/config contract
task_criteria: A reader-facing MCP page documents every tool name that src/mcp/tools/*.ts registers: the sorted documented-name set equals the sorted source-derived set (zero missing, zero invented, both directions proven by a diff of the two lists printed in the commit evidence), and the page states the transport (stdio/SSE), the auth switch and the config knobs. Any documented tool name must exist in source.

items.criterion: A reader-facing MCP page documents every tool name that src/mcp/tools/*.ts registers: the sorted documented-name set equals the sorted source-derived set (zero missing, zero invented, both directions proven by a diff of the two lists printed in the commit evidence), and the page states the transport (stdio/SSE), the auth switch and the config knobs. Any documented tool name must exist in source.
items.detail: Set equality proven by an actual diff: source list `grep -n "name: 'speclang_" src/mcp/tools/index.ts | sed -E "s/.*name: '([^']+)'.*/\1/" | sort` -> 34 names; doc list `grep -oE '^\| `speclang_[a-z_]+`' docs/API_REFERENCE.md | sed -E 's/^\| `([^`]+)`/\1/' | sort -u` -> 34 names; `diff /tmp/src_tools.txt /tmp/doc_tools.txt` printed nothing, exit 0 — zero missing, zero invented, both directions. No other registration site exists (`grep -rn "name: 'speclang_" src/mcp/ --include=*.ts` excluding tools/index.ts -> no hits), and getToolDefinitions (src/mcp/tools/index.ts:378) is the sole source for tools/list (src/mcp/server.ts:145 HTTP, :251 stdio) and the registry switch (tools/index.ts:63). The two non-table mentions of speclang_* in the page (docs/API_REFERENCE.md:211, :303) are all members of the 34-name set, so no invented name appears anywhere. Transport stated at docs/API_REFERENCE.md:180-183 and :198-201 (stdio default via startStdio server.ts:62 / StdioServerTransport server.ts:68; HTTP+SSE via startHTTP server.ts:77, SSEServerTransport server.ts:95, POST /mcp/message server.ts:107, /events server.ts:204, /health server.ts:215, app.listen server.ts:219 — every cited line verified in src/mcp/server.ts). Auth switch stated at :204 (`--auth none|basic|token` default none, `auth.enabled = options.auth !== 'none'` at bin/speclang:1363,1388; middleware mounted on '/mcp' at server.ts:88-90; token Bearer via MCP_API_KEYS or token at auth.ts:67-89; basic exact header at auth.ts:51-62; config_file/tls_client_cert have no CLI flag, auth.ts:36-42). Config knobs stated at :206-224 — all 15 MCP_* variables with defaults and line anchors verified against src/mcp/config.ts:42,45,48,51,54,56,58,61,64,67,70,73,76,79,82 and DEFAULT_CONFIG at config.ts:10-33; the 'loader.ts is unwired' warning is true (no import of config/loader in src/, specs/mcp.spec.dir/src/ or bin/; loader.ts:125-147 uses the conflicting MCP_DB_PATH/MCP_SERVER_MODE/MCP_SERVER_PORT/MCP_SERVER_HOST/MCP_AUTH_TOKEN set). Reader-facing: docs/API_REFERENCE.md is a git symlink (mode 120000) to specs/docs.spec.dir/docs/API_REFERENCE.md and is linked from README.md:152. Tests: `timeout 120 env TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/mcp.test.ts tests/mcp/server.test.ts --passWithNoTests` -> exit 0, 'Test Files 2 passed (2) / Tests 62 passed (62)'. Minor imprecision noted but not a criterion failure: :303 says HTTP-mode `speclang_get_status` returns a placeholder, while src/mcp/server.ts has no such case (grep exit 1) and the `speclang_get` prefix routes to handleDashboardTool (server.ts:321) whose default returns {"error":"Unknown dashboard tool: speclang_get_status"} (server.ts:356) — the doc's own 'or an unknown-dashboard-tool error' clause covers it.

findings.detection: documented env var `SPECLANG_BIN` is set to empty string in the example, but the doc's own text says the candidate list is 'env value, then repo-local bin/speclang, then bare speclang' — an empty env value is a value, not a fallback
findings.detail: The example block sets `SPECLANG_BIN=` (empty), which per the documented candidate-list semantics would be tried as the executable rather than falling through to `bin/speclang`, contradicting the 'unset → <repo>/bin/speclang' default stated in the table row.

findings.detection: documented env var `SPECLANG_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS` is set to `900000` in the example while the table says a non-numeric value becomes NaN and times out immediately — the example is fine, but the doc gives no guidance that an empty value (`SPECLANG_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS=`) would be NaN
findings.detail: The table row warns that plain `Number()` parsing makes non-numeric values NaN, yet the example block style elsewhere in this file uses empty values for optional overrides (e.g. `SPECLANG_MODEL=`, `SPECLANG_BASE_URL=`), so a reader copying that pattern for the timeout would get immediate timeouts.

review.summary: The two new env-var rows are internally consistent with the cited source lines, but the example block's empty `SPECLANG_BIN=` conflicts with the documented fallback semantics and the timeout row lacks the empty-value caveat the file's own example style invites.
